title: 第3章 青元坊市龙玄武第4章 青纹鱼金香灵鱼
content_zh:
“爷爷，您听我说，”李衍道急切地说道，“我展示一下最近修炼的法术，您便会明白我的意思了。”
李松鹤眉头紧锁，一脸不解，但还是同意了李衍道的请求。
只见李衍道走到厅堂中央，轻喝一声，根本没有手捏法诀，便施展出圆满级别的云雨术。
顿时，室内仿佛被一片柔和的雨幕所笼罩，空气中弥漫着清新的水汽，令人震撼不已。
片刻之后，李松鹤终于从震惊中回过神来，颤抖着声音问道：
“孙...孙儿，你何时将这门法术修炼至圆满境界的？”
李衍道见状，微微一笑，随即编织了一个看似合理的解释：
“爷爷，前不久有位高人御空飞过我们风林岛，那位大师见我资质出众，收我为徒，便慷慨地指点了我几句，随后我深有所感，对水属性法术有了更深的顿悟。
自此以后，我对这门法术有了更深的理解，最终达到了圆满的境界。”
对于李家这样一个以练气期修士为主的家族来说，李松鹤所见过的最高境界修士也只是筑基期而已，但对于更高层次的修士，他自然是有所耳闻的。
能够御空飞行的修士，至少也是达到了金丹境界的存在。
“孙儿能得到那位前辈的青睐，实在是我李家的大幸啊！”李松鹤感叹道。
接着，他转向李林一，严肃地嘱咐道：“林一，衍道的这份天赋绝对不能轻易示人，最多给族人透露一二。
有了衍道的能力，我们李家今后在灵植一道必定能够大展宏图。”
说完，李松鹤的面容上难掩喜悦之情。
李家虽然占据了一条一阶灵脉，但在灵植一道却并不具备显着优势。
主要原因在于家族中仅有三位成员掌握了云雨术，除了李衍道之外，另外两位族人的云雨术仅停留在入门阶段。
此外，灵田的开辟也是一项极其复杂的任务。
如果没有灵脉上的灵穴作为支持，就需要消耗大量的灵贝粉末或灵石碎片，再辅以蕴灵阵法来进行滋养。
通常情况下，没有数十块灵石的投入，是难以成功开辟出一亩灵田的。

正因为这些限制，李家目前仅开辟了三亩灵田，而这三亩灵田全部用于种植水灵米。
最为棘手的是，其中只有一亩灵田能够达到每亩约四百斤的产量，而其余两亩的产量则仅有每亩两百斤左右。
水灵米是一年一熟的灵物，属于最低等级的一阶下品灵米，主要用来满足炼气期修士的修炼需求。
因此在市场上售价较低，大约一块灵石可以购买十五到三十斤。
李家凭借现有的三亩灵田，每年能够收获的灵石大概在三四十块左右。
而此前李衍道展示的云雨术，实际上只是达到了小成级别。
法术的熟练度分为入门、小成、大成以及圆满四个层级。
从小成到大成再到圆满，不仅是灵力精纯度的提升，更是施法范围与效果的飞跃。
小成级别的云雨术，在灌溉灵田的面积和灵力的充沛程度上，都远逊于大成乃至圆满级别的云雨术。
若小成级别的云雨术能使灵田亩产达到四百斤，那么圆满级别的云雨术至少可以使亩产翻倍，达到八百斤以上。
同时，圆满级别的云雨术还能使可管理的灵田数量增加一倍以上。
李衍道之所以编造出一位师尊的故事，正是为了日后能够更加合理地展示他所拥有的其他水属性法术和其他天赋。
他在最近才开始展露这些能力，主要是因为他最近刚刚晋升到了炼气六层，所需的修炼资源显着增加。
而胖头鲤作为一阶下品灵鱼，所提供的灵力已经无法满足他快速修炼的需求。
第二天清晨，李松鹤便带领着李衍道来到了家族开辟的灵田所在地。
这片三亩灵田的开辟，当初耗费了家族整整一百五十块灵石，包括一套一阶下品的蕴灵阵以及数十块灵石的灵贝碎屑。
这套阵法正好覆盖了三亩灵田，并且每年需要三块灵石来维持运作。
当李衍道展示了他圆满级别的云雨术后，李松鹤似乎看到了家族摆脱灵石短缺困境的曙光，内心激动不已。
“孙儿，你现在在不影响修炼的情况下，能够打理多少灵田呢？”李松鹤询问道。
content_en:
"Grandpa, listen to me," Li Yandao said eagerly, "I will show you the spells I have recently practiced, and you will understand what I mean."
Li Songhe frowned and looked puzzled, but he still agreed to Li Yandao's request.
I saw Li Yandao walking to the center of the hall, shouting softly, and performing the Yun Yu Technique at the perfect level without using his hands at all.
Suddenly, the room seemed to be shrouded in a soft curtain of rain, and the air was filled with fresh water vapor, which was shocking.
After a while, Li Songhe finally recovered from the shock and asked in a trembling voice:
"Sun... grandson, when did you practice this magic to perfection?"
Li Yandao smiled slightly when he saw this, and then weaved a seemingly reasonable explanation:
"Grandpa, not long ago, an expert flew over our Fenglin Island. The master saw that I had outstanding qualifications and accepted me as his disciple. He generously gave me some pointers, and then I felt deeply about it and had a deeper understanding of water-based magic.
Since then, I have gained a deeper understanding of the art and finally reached a state of perfection. "
For a family like the Li family, which mainly has Qi-training stage monks, the highest-level monks Li Songhe has ever seen were only in the Foundation-building stage, but he has naturally heard of higher-level monks.
A monk who can fly in the air has at least reached the golden elixir realm.
"It is really a great blessing for my Li family that my grandson can be favored by that senior!" Li Songhe sighed.
Then, he turned to Li Linyi and said seriously: "Lin Yi, Yandao's talent must not be revealed to others easily. At most, it should be revealed to the clan members.
With the ability to expand Dao, our Li family will definitely be able to achieve great success in Lingzhi in the future. "
After saying that, Li Songhe couldn't hide the joy on his face.
Although the Li family occupies a first-order spiritual vein, it does not have a significant advantage in Lingzhi.
The main reason is that only three members of the family have mastered the Yun Yu Technique. Except for Li Yandao, the other two clan members' Yun Yu Technique is only at the introductory stage.
In addition, the development of spiritual fields is also an extremely complex task.
If there is no support from the spiritual points on the spiritual veins, it is necessary to consume a large amount of spiritual shell powder or spiritual stone fragments, and then supplement it with the spiritual formation method for nourishment.
Under normal circumstances, it is difficult to successfully develop an acre of spiritual land without the investment of dozens of spiritual stones.
Because of these restrictions, the Li family has only developed three acres of spiritual land, and these three acres of spiritual land are all used to grow Shuiling rice.
The most troublesome thing is that only one mu of spiritual field can achieve a yield of about 400 kilograms per mu, while the yield of the remaining two acres is only about 200 kilograms per mu.
Water spirit rice is a spiritual object that ripens once a year. It belongs to the lowest level of first-grade low-grade spiritual rice. It is mainly used to meet the cultivation needs of monks in the Qi refining period.
Therefore, the price in the market is relatively low. About one piece of spiritual stone can buy fifteen to thirty kilograms.
With the existing three acres of spiritual land, the Li family can harvest about thirty or forty yuan of spiritual stones every year.
The cloud and rain technique that Li Yandao demonstrated before was actually only at the Xiaocheng level.
The proficiency of spells is divided into four levels: Beginner, Minor, Dacheng and Perfect.
From small success to great success and then to perfection, it is not only an improvement in the purity of spiritual power, but also a leap in the scope and effect of spell casting.
The Yunyu Technique at the Xiaocheng level is far inferior to the Yunyu Technique at the Great Success or even Perfect level in terms of the area of ​​irrigated spiritual fields and the abundance of spiritual energy.
If the Yun Yu technique at the Xiaocheng level can increase the yield per mu of the spiritual field to 400 jins, then the Yun Yu technique at the perfect level can at least double the yield per mu to more than 800 jins.
At the same time, the perfect level of Yunyu Technique can more than double the number of manageable spiritual fields.
The reason why Li Yandao made up the story of a master was so that he could more reasonably demonstrate his other water-attribute spells and other talents in the future.
he isHe has only recently begun to display these abilities, mainly because he has just been promoted to the sixth level of Qi Refining, and the required training resources have increased significantly.
As a first-order low-grade spiritual fish, the spiritual power provided by the fat-headed carp could no longer meet his needs for rapid cultivation.
Early the next morning, Li Songhe led Li Yandao to the location of the spiritual field opened by his family.
The development of this three-acre spiritual field originally cost the family a total of one hundred and fifty spiritual stones, including a set of first-level low-grade spiritual formations and dozens of spiritual shell fragments from spiritual stones.
This formation covers exactly three acres of spiritual fields, and requires three spiritual stones every year to maintain its operation.
When Li Yandao demonstrated his perfect level of Yunyu surgery, Li Songhe seemed to see the dawn of the family getting rid of the shortage of spiritual stones, and he was very excited.
"Grandson, how many spiritual fields can you take care of now without affecting your cultivation?" Li Songhe asked.
